simulation_effects: LivingSim may represent a local charter, workshop capacity, safety strain, contract pressure and maintenance backlog without assigning sovereign control.
Living Scale may show a local presence only when a chapter has location reference, scope, provenance and charter or community consent.

story_generators: A safety inspection prevents a collapse but threatens a town's only income before winter.
A licensed route is interrupted, forcing the League and Collegiate to negotiate the cost of emergency repairs.
An independent workshop invokes local autonomy against both organizations while its apprentices demand protection.
